# <playbook_cite>Following entry [missing_guidance]: extracting movie titles/directors from the Simple Note 'Movie Recommendations' note</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure if all movie titles map 1:1 to standalone lines and whether some titles contain extra formatting; will parse robustly.</uncertainty>

import re
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sn_password = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=sn_password)['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=sn_token)
content = note.get('content','')
print('note_title:', note.get('title'))
print('content_length:', len(content))

# Parse movies and director lines.
# Expect blocks like:
# Movie Title
#  - director: Name
#  - genre: ...

lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]
movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for ln in lines:
    if not ln.strip():
        continue
    if ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Detect title line: starts with non-bullet, non-dash, non-director.
    if re.match(r'^\s*[-*]', ln):
        # bullet line
        m = re.match(r'^\s*[-*]\s*director\s*:\s*(.*)$', ln, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            current_director = m.group(1).strip()
        continue
    # Maybe genre line or others also start with '-'; ignore.
    m_dir = re.match(r'^\s*director\s*:\s*(.*)$', ln, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_dir:
        current_director = m_dir.group(1).strip()
        continue
    # If line has 'director:' but not bullet
    if 'director:' in ln.lower():
        m = re.search(r'director\s*:\s*(.*)', ln, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m:
            current_director = m.group(1).strip()
        continue

    # Title line candidate if it doesn't contain ':'
    if ':' not in ln and not ln.strip().startswith('-'):
        # flush previous movie if had director
        if current_title is not None and current_director is not None:
            movies.append({'title': current_title, 'director': current_director})
        current_title = ln.strip()
        current_director = None

# flush last
if current_title is not None and current_director is not None:
    movies.append({'title': current_title, 'director': current_director})

print('parsed_movies_count:', len(movies))
print('sample:', movies[:10])

fincher = [m['title'] for m in movies if m.get('director','').lower().find('fincher')!=-1]
print('fincher_titles:', fincher)

# In case director lines are missed due to parsing, also directly extract director mapping with regex
# Title is line followed by '- director:' line.
block_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<title>.+?)\n\s*-\s*director\s*:\s*(?P<director>.+?)\n', re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
matches = block_re.findall(content)
print('regex_block_matches:', len(matches))
# normalize titles
fincher2 = [t.strip() for t,d in matches if 'fincher' in d.lower()]
print('fincher2_titles:', fincher2)
